title: Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep) - The Tropical Paradise of the Andaman Islands
content:
Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep)

Havelock Island, officially renamed Swaraj Dweep in 2018, is the most popular tourist destination in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Located approximately 70 kilometers northeast of Port Blair, the island is renowned for its white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, lush tropical forests, and world-class scuba diving sites.

Whether you're planning a honeymoon, a family vacation, a solo adventure, or a beach holiday, Havelock Island offers unforgettable experiences. From relaxing on the award-winning Radhanagar Beach to exploring vibrant coral reefs at Elephant Beach, every corner of the island showcases nature at its finest.

History of Havelock Island

The island was originally named after British General Sir Henry Havelock during the colonial period. In December 2018, the Government of India officially renamed it Swaraj Dweep to honor India's freedom movement and commemorate Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's historic visit to the Andaman Islands in 1943.

Over the past two decades, Havelock Island has transformed into India's premier island tourism destination while maintaining its ecological beauty and environmental conservation efforts.

Why Visit Havelock Island?

Havelock Island is famous for:

  • Award-winning beaches
  • Crystal-clear turquoise waters
  • World-class scuba diving
  • Colorful coral reefs
  • Snorkeling adventures
  • Sea walking
  • Mangrove kayaking
  • Luxury beach resorts
  • Romantic honeymoon experiences
  • Spectacular sunsets

It is widely considered the crown jewel of Andaman tourism.

Top Attractions in Havelock Island

1. Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7)

Radhanagar Beach is the island's most famous attraction and has consistently been ranked among Asia's best beaches.

Highlights include:

  • Soft white sand
  • Crystal-clear water
  • Stunning sunsets
  • Swimming
  • Photography
  • Peaceful atmosphere

The beach is perfect for relaxing and enjoying nature.

2. Elephant Beach

Elephant Beach is known for its exciting water sports and rich marine biodiversity.

Popular activities include:

  • Snorkeling
  • Scuba diving
  • Sea walking
  • Jet skiing
  • Glass-bottom boat rides

The coral reefs here are among the healthiest in the Andaman Islands.

3. Kalapathar Beach

Kalapathar Beach is famous for its black volcanic rocks, peaceful surroundings, and breathtaking sunrise views.

It is ideal for:

  • Photography
  • Morning walks
  • Relaxation
  • Scenic drives

4. Vijaynagar Beach

This quiet beach is lined with palm trees and luxury resorts.

Visitors enjoy:

  • Beach walks
  • Swimming
  • Kayaking
  • Peaceful evenings

Adventure Activities

Snorkeling

  • The shallow reefs around Elephant Beach make snorkeling accessible to all visitors.
  • Colorful corals and marine life are easily visible through the clear waters.

Sea Walking

  • Sea walking offers a unique underwater experience without requiring swimming skills.
  • Visitors walk along the seabed while wearing specially designed helmets.

Kayaking

  • Mangrove kayaking is one of the island's most peaceful activities.
  • Paddling through dense mangrove forests allows visitors to experience the island's rich biodiversity.

Marine Biodiversity

Havelock Island is home to an incredible underwater ecosystem.

Visitors may encounter:

  • Clownfish
  • Butterflyfish
  • Parrotfish
  • Sea turtles
  • Rays
  • Sea cucumbers
  • Hard corals
  • Soft corals

The island's waters are considered among the best diving locations in Asia.

Best Time to Visit

  • October to May: The ideal season with pleasant weather and calm seas.
  • November to April: Best period for scuba diving, snorkeling, and beach activities.
  • June to September: Monsoon season brings rainfall and rough seas, though the island remains lush and beautiful.

How to Reach Havelock Island

By Air

Fly to Veer Savarkar International Airport in Port Blair.

By Ferry

Regular government and private ferries connect Port Blair with Havelock Island.

The journey takes approximately 1.5 to 2.5 hours depending on the ferry service.

Advance booking is recommended during the tourist season.

Accommodation

Havelock Island offers accommodation for every budget:

  • Luxury beach resorts
  • Boutique hotels
  • Mid-range resorts
  • Budget guesthouses
  • Eco-friendly cottages
  • Beachfront villas

Many properties provide direct beach access.

Local Cuisine

Visitors can enjoy:

  • Fresh seafood
  • Fish curry
  • Grilled prawns
  • Lobster
  • Coconut-based dishes
  • South Indian cuisine
  • Continental cuisine

Beachside cafés offer scenic dining experiences.

Travel Tips

  • Book ferry tickets in advance.
  • Reserve scuba diving slots early.
  • Carry reef-safe sunscreen.
  • Avoid touching coral reefs.
  • Keep beaches clean.
  • Carry cash for smaller establishments.
  • Wear lightweight clothing and comfortable footwear.

Nearby Attractions

Popular places to visit from Havelock Island include:

  • Elephant Beach
  • Radhanagar Beach
  • Kalapathar Beach
  • Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
  • Port Blair

Why You Should Visit

Havelock Island perfectly combines luxury, adventure, and natural beauty. Whether you wish to relax on award-winning beaches, dive into vibrant coral reefs, kayak through mangroves, or enjoy romantic sunsets, the island promises an unforgettable tropical getaway.
excerpt: Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep) is the most popular tourist destination in the Andaman Islands, known for its pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and world-class scuba diving. Home to the famous Radhanagar Beach and Elephant Beach, the island offers the perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and natural beauty. It is a must-visit destination for anyone exploring the Andaman archipelago.
